evidence.rationale: principle_decide scored the three capture UXs on human_cognitive_load (and maintainability/reusability/schema-grounding). plain-chip-multiselect won with high confidence: nine plain-language toggle chips reusing the existing compliance-scope chip pattern, no jargon or typing, card-payments kept as its existing checkbox. Rejected the raw-predicate dropdown (exposes machine keys, higher load) and coworker-only capture (forces a conversational detour for a simple tick-what-applies declaration; the coworker path still ships in phase 3 as an additional route).
